scope: Explicit bounded engineering distributions for public-data gaps. These values make simulation and ablation reproducible; none is a claim of deployed A7/L20 hardware calibration.

natural_pedicel_orientation.rationale: S09 identifies category prevalence but not a continuous local tilt density. The smooth within-category model preserves those measured probabilities and stays inside the already qualified 15 degree fruit-stem workspace envelope.

abscission_zone_shear.mode_derivation: S05 distal pedicel cutting mean divided by the 6.27 mm abscission tensile mean: 33.241 / 44.781 = 0.7423.
abscission_zone_shear.classification: ENGINEERING_HYPERPARAMETER constrained by an adjacent-section experiment
abscission_zone_shear.replacement_gate: Replace with target-cultivar abscission-zone lateral load tests; do not relabel the cutting fixture as direct AZ shear.

cyclic_fatigue.rationale: S08 supports fatigue under reciprocating combined loading but does not identify constants. The time support is bounded by the 0.26-1.56 s human separation-stage reference, with a conservative lower tail for full-capacity loading.
cyclic_fatigue.replacement_gate: Fit force-displacement-cycle traces for the target cultivar, holding reward and PPO fixed.

g20_pad_tomato_contact.rationale: The friction support contains the S03 tomato-on-rubber mean 0.305 while allowing textured-pad and surface-condition uncertainty. The stiffness mode is the S03 whole-fruit rupture secant 51.27 N / 0.00952 m = 5385 N/m; it is only an effective rigid-body contact surrogate.
g20_pad_tomato_contact.replacement_gate: Incline-slip and 1/2/3/5 mm compression tests on the deployed pad, cultivar, ripeness and wetness states.

a7_l20_effective_actuator.task_naming_note: The task historically says G20; the checked-in vendor model and current Physics-v1 profile identify the hand as Linker Hand L20.
a7_l20_effective_actuator.rationale: Vendor URDF/manual limits are used as hard envelopes. The implicit gains, armature and 0-2 policy-step delay are simulation priors that passed the existing Isaac gates but are not identified controller dynamics.
a7_l20_effective_actuator.replacement_gate: Timestamped isolated A7 joint steps and L20 open/close/reversal trials with measured joint position, velocity and effort.
